step5_question.question_previous_version: Based on Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what is P&G's capital expenditure ratio for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare to fiscal 2025? Round to two decimal places.
step5_question.gt_template:
The Capital Expenditure Ratio is Capital Expenditures divided by Net Sales.
For 2026:
Capital Expenditures = $[[Capex@FY2026]] million
Net Sales = $[[Rev@FY2026]] million
Capital Expenditure Ratio = $[[Capex@FY2026]] million / $[[Rev@FY2026]] million = [[CapexRatio@FY2026|.2f]]%

For 2025:
Capital Expenditures = $[[Capex@FY2025]] million
Net Sales = $[[Rev@FY2025]] million
Capital Expenditure Ratio = $[[Capex@FY2025]] million / $[[Rev@FY2025]] million = [[CapexRatio@FY2025|.2f]]%

The ratio [[!CapexRatio_change]] from [[CapexRatio@FY2025|.2f]]% in 2025 to [[CapexRatio@FY2026|.2f]]% in 2026.
